formats.event_header: array of u32: < 0x10000 = terminal (finish; value stored to the caller's state word), else node pointer
formats.node: u16 next (LE) | u8 kind | u8 arg | payload; after the node finishes the event continues at `next` unless a bytecode node ends with exactly 1 value on the stack (that value becomes the next index)

node_kinds.1: text box, UTF-16 inline at +4 (arg = box style)
node_kinds.2: text box, UTF-16 at [+4] with printf args computed by bytecode at +8
node_kinds.3: choice prompt, UTF-16 inline at +4 (lines starting with "-" are options)
node_kinds.4: bytecode, headerless Webfoot-LZ stream at +4 (inflated to a 0x800 buffer)
node_kinds.5: text box, packed text-bank ref at +4: bank = v&0x3F (table 0x087B5B64, LZ container), offset = ((v>>6)&0x7FFF)*2, length = (v>>21)*2 bytes
node_kinds.6: kind 5 text + printf args from bytecode at +8
node_kinds.7: goto: continue with event header at +4, node 0

formats.condition_word: 0 = true; 0x0001xxxx flag xxxx set; 0x0002xxxx clear; 0x0003xxxx set (and clears it); ROM ptr = bytecode returning bool

nodes.text: !Previously in DRAGON BALL Z: LEGACY OF GOKU 2...
!Goku's son, Gohan was able to tap into his deepest powers and finally destroy the monstrous Cell.
!Finally, after years of turmoil caused by Dr. Gero's Androids, the Earth was brought back to normal...
!Except for one thing...
!Goku, who was killed in a desperate attempt to defeat Cell, could not be revived by the powers of the Earth's Dragon...
!And despite a clever plan to bring him back to life, Goku decided it'd be safer for the Earth if he didn't return....
!And so, friends and family were forced to say goodbye to the Saiyan they loved...
Despite this terrible loss, the world was finally at peace...Or was it?
!Somewhere on planet Earth, something ancient and horrible was sleeping...a terror beyond imagination!
!And the forces of evil were preparing to awaken it from its primeval imprisonment.

nodes.text: #I've ridden on slugs faster than this vehicle!
!Oh, be quiet, Vegeta.
#Say... Vegeta... And this goes for Goten and Trunks as well.I think we should all agree not to go Super Saiyan at the tournament.
#What for?

!It's a good idea. This way no one will recognize you guys from the Cell Games.If they did, the journalists would get your names off of the entry forms and there would be TV cameras all over our front lawn!
#I don't see the problem. When the journalists come, we'll just destroy them!
#I'm serious, Vegeta. It could be a big problem.
#Fine. It's settled. There will be no Super Saiyan transformations in the battles.I'll still have the advantage.
!That's good news for me. Maybe this way I'll stand a chance!Fighting a Super Saiyan is like fighting a steamroller with your hands tied!
!Hey, guys! We're here!

nodes.text: !You boys found all the Dragon Balls?  Great! Give them to me!
!But Mom, Goten's dad said we should bring them back to Kami's Lookout.
!Listen to your mother, Trunks! I need the Dragon Balls.
@Bulma takes the Dragon Balls and Dragon Radar.
!Awww, Mom...
So... How does this work? Does the dragon just pop out of them? I find that hard to believe.
You aren't very bright, are you?
Oolong! Mind your manners.
I'm not that naïve, you know. I just have never seen a magical wish granting dragon before!
Eternal Dragon! By your name, I summon you forth!SHENRON!
This can't be real! I must be dreaming!
You, who have disturbed me from my slumber, speak! And name your wish!
Hmmm... How should I phrase this wish?
I thought you had this all figured out. Shenron! Bring everyone who died today back to life! Except for the really bad ones!
It is done. Now name your second wish!
Did he just say "second wish"? Oh, no! I'm too late!
Goku? What do you mean?
There's no time to explain! Shenron! You don't have to grant anymore wishes today! Thanks! We'll call you again some time!
As you wish. Farewell.
What's gotten into you, Goku? We still had a perfectly good wish left!

The monster Majin Buu is still out there. There's been a lot of stuff going on that you guys haven't seen.I have a feeling we're going to need that wish later. In the meantime, we should all go to Kami's Lookout.It may be one of the only safe places left on this planet... At least for now...I can take you there using instant transmission!
Every time I think things couldn't get any weirder, they do!
Are you coming with us, Videl?
Of course!

nodes.text: !We needed to use Spopovich and Yamu to find the wizard who is controlling them.
!A wizard?

!Yes. When the human race was still in it's infancy on Earth, a powerful wizard named Bibidi appeared.With him he brought a terrible monster, whose only purpose was destruction.That monsters name was Majin Buu. This monster's only desire was to eliminate all living things.Hundreds of planets were reduced to rubble by him. Entire galaxies were wiped from existence.
!That sounds awful... So what happened to him?

!After a while Majin Buu became so powerful that even Bibidi could not control him. Bibidi used a spell to seal Majin Buu inside a ball where he lay dormant. Bibidi used the spell to transport Buu from planet to planet, until the ball was brought here to Earth. The Earth was meant to be Buu's next target.
!No! That's terrible!
!But before Buu could be released, Bibidi was killed, and the ball containing Buu has remained here on Earth to this very day!
!I don't get it! Why couldn't someone destroy Buu while he was inside the ball?

!That's a good question. As long as Bibidi could never do the spell to release Buu from the ball,Buu was no longer a threat. However, Bibidi had a son. He named his son Babidi. Babidi is on Earth right now as we speak! He intends to continue his father's work and unleash Majin Buu upon the universe once again!
!I see... So what do Spopovich and Yamu have to do with all this?

!Babidi is not very physically strong, but as a wizard he does not need to be.Instead, his magic enables him to harness the evil that exists in the hearts of people like Yamu and Spopovich, and thereby control their actions. In order to resurrect Majin Buu, Babidi requires a tremendous amount of pure energy!
!So they came after me!
!That's right. The Supreme Kai, the one you know as "Mr. Shin," was the one who defeated Bibidi so many ages ago. We have come here to Earth to stop him.
!I see your father and the others up ahead. Let's catch up with them!
!Hey, Dad!
!Gohan! I suppose Kibito has filled you in?
!Yep! It sounds like we have our work cut out for us.
!I see Spopovich and Yamu landing over there. Everyone try to suppress your energy.We don't want them to know we're here yet.

nodes.text: Hey, where did you find that puppy, Buu?
He no scared of Buu. He no run. Me try saying words to him, but he no talk.
It looks like the poor little guy hurt his leg. Maybe that's why he didn't run away.
You leg broken? Me make it better then you can run away.
Why you no run away? He not so scared of Buu.
He's thanking you for fixing his leg! You're his new best friend. He wants you to play with him!
Buu friends with you and puppy now!
Sure! We're all friends!
Hey, Buu! I have to go get something. I'll be right back!
Okay!
Haha! Now all I have to do is press the button on this remote, and Buu's house will explode! KA-BOOM!
But... He looks different... Gentle... Maybe I should give this guy a little time. Who knows? Maybe if people can change, he can too!
Excuse me, Mr. Buu. Can I ask you a personal question?
Okay.
Why do you fly around killing people and destroying our cities?
Buu was told to. Bibidi told Buu to kill people. Babidi told Buu to destroy things.
You don't have to listen to them, you know.
What Buu does if not destroying things?
There's lots of things you can do! You can go to the movies, play with your puppy, watch football. Anything as long as it doesn't involve destruction.
Is to kill people a bad thing?
Yes. A very bad thing.
Then Buu kill no more!
(I did it! I got this guy to change his ways and I didn't even have to throw a punch or blow him up! Oh, Hercule, you truly are the greatest!)

nodes.text: Hi!
You're alive? I was certain you'd been disposed of by Vegeta. Well, that's good, because I was worried I wouldn't be able to thank you for helping me bring Majin Buu back to life.
We would have never have let you succeed if we knew your monster was so powerful.
So why did you come here? Did you just want to come and tell us how powerful we are? Or did you come here to join us?
I'm actually here to give you a warning.
A warning? Oh that's hilarious! I think you've struck comedy gold! I think I'm going to broadcast this to the entire planet! They should all see this.
Listen carefully. The three people you are looking for will appear very soon. That I promise. So if I were you, I wouldn't touch another thing until they get here.
Why should we stop? Are they planning something special for us?
Yes. And once they're finished training, they'll destroy you.
Well, that's nice. But I think instead we'll just continue destroying everything. Starting with the Capsule Corporation!
If you want to get to the Capsule Corporation, you'll have to get past me!
It sounds to me that you want to end up like your friend Vegeta. Buu take care of this cretin!
Okay. I do it.
I don't get it, Buu. You're a million times stronger than Babidi, and yet you let him boss you around like that.
Huh?
Don't listen to him, Buu! Do you want to be stuck inside your ball for another million years?
No worry. Buu no like this guy more than you!
Well, I guess it was worth a try...
People of Earth! Watch this very carefully! It will be a wonderful example of what will happen to anyone who tries to stand in my way!
Here we go!
Not this trick again. We've seen it before...
I guess Ascended Super Saiyan isn't that much of a challenge for you... So how about I take things up to the next level!
The next level of what?
I guess I'm going to have to give you guys a demonstration.
I thought I would teach you a bit about Super Saiyans, starting with the basics.
Super... Saiya... Jin?
You're going to love this. What you see now is my normal state.
This is a Super Saiyan.
And this is what's known as a Super Saiyan that has ascended beyond the level of Super Saiyan. I suppose you could call it Super Saiyan 2.
What a useless transformation. So what? You changed the color of your hair. Big deal!
Just wait... This is to go further beyond...
I'm sorry that took so long, but I haven't had much time to practice this one. This is what I call  Super Saiyan 3 .
Goku has learned Super Saiyan 3! Super Saiyan 3 is far more powerful than the normal Super Saiyan technique. You must become a Super Saiyan before you can use Super Saiyan 3.
Buu not scared! Big hair make you look big funny!
I'm inclined to agree. This "Super Three" whatever you said is ridiculous! Majin Buu, I think our friend is in need of a haircut!
I'm ready. Show me what you got?

nodes.text: Why you go back to normal? You and me no fight no more? Buu was having fun!
Well, I had a lot of fun too, Buu. Unfortunately, I have some place else to be and I can't play with you all day. It's time to say goodbye!
Wait a second! I decide when you get to leave!
Hold it a second. I'm asking you to have some patience. Goten, Trunks, and Piccolo will come to you in due time and then you'll get a real fight.
Are they strong?
Unbelievably strong!
Like it really matters! It won't make a difference.No one will ever be strong enough to beat the two of us!
Majin Buu, I think you're too gifted a fighter to be controlled by a coward like Babidi! Don't you think? Gotta go! See ya!
Did he just disappear in thin air? Buu!!! Don't just stand there! Get your pink doughy body moving and find him!
Do you have wax in your ears, bonehead? I gave you an order!
Master Babidi... Buu has a better idea... Buu have a great idea!
Okay, then. Why don't you tell me what you came up with using that walnut-sized brain of yours?
Now Babidi no talk. Now no more can say words to seal Buu back up in ball!

nodes.text: Meanwhile, millions of light years above, along the winding track of Snake Way, Goku was adjusting well to life in the Other World...
I forgot how long Snake Way was!
Listen, King Kai, can't you run any faster? We're not making very good time!
How many times can I say this? We can't make bad time here because in this world time never runs out!
But I still can't wait to see this Master of Other World you told me about!Talk about the ultimate fighting challenge!
I have to tell you, Goku... You better not think lightly of him or you're gonna be in trouble...

Maybe if I explain... You know I am King Kai, and I watch over the Earth, and your part of space, but the universe is divided into four quadrants. There's the north, south, east, and west quadrants, each with their own King Kai. But further above us is the Grand Kai. He rules over the Kais themselves!
And he's also a martial arts master with a planet full of fighters! Which is why we have to get there right away! Say... How do we get to the Grand Kai's planet anyway?
You have to take a plane. It's called " The Higher Plane " and it's docked next to  King Yemma's Castle  at the end of Snake Way.
Thanks, King Kai! I don't want to be late so I'm going to run ahead! See you there!

nodes.text: Hey, King Yemma!
Goku! Thanks for defeating Janemba! Everything is back to normal here... Well almost normal...
I have a favor to ask. Could you see if my son, Gohan, came through here?
Do you realize what you're asking of me? I've just processed a million souls! And there are even more waiting in line outside!
Yeah. The Earth is under siege by Majin Buu. In fact, I wouldn't be surprised if the whole population ended up here before long.
The whole population?
But I think my son, Gohan, can help us avoid that. I just need to know if he's here or still on Earth! Do you mind seeing if he's checked in yet?
Very well. Let me check the books.
I don't see any Gohans in here.
You mean he's still alive? That's great!!!
By the way, Goku... Did you know a guy named Dabura?
Sure did.

He came through here a while back. He was quite a handful. He was supposed to go below to H.F.I.L., but being the demon king and all I figured he'd enjoy it! So instead I gave him the stamp of approval to go to Heaven!
Now I wonder... If Gohan isn't here, where is he?
Please don't bother me now. I have so much work to do!

nodes.text: What happened here?
Goku! You've got to help me get out of here!
King Yemma! What's going on?

An evil spirit named Janemba has taken over the Other World! Janemba was an organized crime kingpin in the Demon World before he came here. He's extremely dangerous! I already sent Pikkon after him, and he never came back. You have to stop him!
Don't worry about it! I'll take care of it!

I don't think you understand how much trouble we're in! If Janemba isn't defeated, the living world and the Other World will merge, destroying the entire balance of the universe! If I were you, I'd get some help.
Help? From who?
A friend of yours. I recently sent him down to HFIL.
You mean Vegeta?
That's right. There might be a problem, however. The Other World Airport isn't accessible right now! So you're going to have a hard time getting around!
Oh, that's not a problem. You forgot about my Instant Transmission Technique! It's the only way to fly!

Use  Instant Transmission Circles  to travel around the Other World! Stand on the circle, and press
the  A Button . The  Other World map  will appear. Use the +Control Pad to select your destination and press the  A Button  to travel.
Journal Entry: Find Vegeta and  defeat Janemba .

nodes.text: If Gohan isn't here, then why can I feel his energy? It seems like he's in the Other World...Where could he be?
Of course! He must be with the Supreme Kai!
Dad? What are you doing here?
Ahhhhhh! Watch where you're swinging that thing! Hey, what's with the fancy clothes?
The Supreme Kai gave them to me. You like?
Oh, hey, Supreme Kai!
!Greetings, Goku!
!Impossible! How did you get to the sacred world of the Kais? No one besides the Supreme Kai and myself even know where this place is located!
Easy! I just used the Instant Transmission technique to home in on Gohan's unique energy signature!
Hey, Gohan... How did you get here anyway?
Well... After I tried to fight Buu, I was knocked unconscious.Supreme Kai and Kibito healed me and then brought me here to train!
Which reminds me...  Kibito, how did you survive Dabura's attack on you?
!The truth is, I didn't! But I suddenly found myself mysteriously alive and back on Earth!I don't know why...
Oh! You must have been wished back when Bulma used the Dragon Balls!
Say, Gohan, where did you get that neat sword?
Well that's a bit of a long story...
This isn't right! Gohan doesn't belong in a place like this! No living mortal has ever stood upon this sacred ground!
I brought Gohan here to get the Z-Sword. It's the only way that Majin Buu can be defeated now.
The Z-Sword? You can't be serious. How could a mere Earthling do what the Kais themselves could not?
I am certain that Gohan is the right one to wield the Z-Sword.
He won't pull the Z-Sword from that rock. I can guarantee it!
Excuse me! What is the Z-Sword?

At the top of this mountain, there is a sword imbedded into the rock. The sword holds an unimaginable power! I believe you will be the one to pull it out. No one else has done it. If you can pull it from the rock, you will be the first!
Journal Entry: Pull the Z-Sword from the rock.

Oh... Sorry... I guess it is more impressive than your planet.Especially since your planet was blown up when Cell exploded!

nodes.text: Pikkon is the better fighter!
Goku is the better fighter!
Pikkon!
Goku!
PIKKON!
GOKU!
Whoa! Look at all the Kais! Hey King Kai, why did you shout my name?
I'm having an argument with West Kai. He says his fighter Pikkon is the best fighter in the universe.
As you must know, Pikkon is the prize fighter of the West Quadrant! In fact, just the other day, the Grand Kai himself called for him to stop an uprising in H.F.I.L.
The Home for Infinite Losers. I've been there before when I fell off of Snake Way!
King Yemma sent some evil guy down there named Cell and he met some guy named Frieza and they took over the whole place!
Cell and Frieza!
Pikkon was able to take care of both of them no problem! I bet this Goku couldn't do that.
Well Frieza was no problem... But Cell--
Never mind that! Goku is a righteous fighter who's saved his side of the galaxy many times!He's an incredibly strong guy!
Listen guys, a reunion is no time for an argument!This is the first time all four Kais have been together in three hundred years!
He's right, you know. Instead of arguing, we should prove which one of us is the best with a  martial arts tournament !
Did I hear someone say tournament?
Grand Kai!
I think a tournament is a radical idea. And to make things exciting, I'll throw in a  free private lesson  for whoever brings home the gold!
You mean the winner of the tournament gets a free lesson from you?
That sure beats training for ten thousand years.
The tournament will be held in my house . I'll see everyone there!
Journal Entry: Go to the  Other World Tournament  in the Grand Kai's house.

What's he doing?
He's calling his parents!
My gosh! They're huge!
They're Chobi's parents. Go home Chobi! You're safe now!
Wow, Gohan, I'm so sorry I doubted you.

HA! I got you! You're Gohan!
What? I don't know what you're talking about.

My dad was the last champion, and I heard that before him, a guy named Goku was the champion. I did a little research on this Goku guy, and he had a son named Gohan. You're his son, aren't you?
Uhhh... No!
I knew it. You're a terrible liar, Gohan. You are Goku's son! This is great!The former champ's daughter fighting the former champ's son!
Yeah... Great...
It's settled then! See you later!
Great, now what do I do? If I tell mom I'm entering the tournament, she's going to kill me!

nodes.text: !Good morning, my young scholars...Today we are being graced with a new class member who actually knows how to read...
!That's your cue, my boy!
!Hi! My name's Gohan! Nice to meet you!
!Gohan here made perfect scores on all his entry exams. English. Math. Chemistry.Many of you could learn from his example!
Hi, Gohan! My name is Erasa!
This is my friend, Videl.
You'll never believe who her father is!
Oh?
Yeah! She's Hercule's daughter.
Hercule? Must be neat being a celebrity's daughter and all!
Wait a second... It's you!
Huh?
You're the guy who I saw outside the bank this morning.
Oh. Yeah.
So you saw the Gold Fighter then?
The... Gold... Fighter?
You're really out of the loop aren't you, Gohan? He's a crime fighter with super strength and magic powers!They say he looks like a teenage boy with golden hair!
(Uh, oh... They've already made a legend out of me!)
I just remembered something... I heard that the Gold Fighter was wearing a black vest and red pants.Does that sound familiar?
Whoa! That's funny. Gohan and the Gold Fighter dress alike!
Yeah... That's funny...
He's not the Gold Fighter if that's what you're thinking.Who's ever heard of a little book nerd secretly being a super hero?
Don't listen to him, Gohan. I bet you could be a super hero if you wanted.
Even if it were possible, Gohan's hair isn't golden... Of course, there were those fighters in the Cell game videos... They turned their hair gold.
Your dad said that was a cheap trick!
I guess you're right.
...and that's why you should never, ever put a capsule inside another capsule.Alright, that will be all for today, class. There will be a test on today's lecture on Friday.

That Goku! Who does he think he is? We throw this big party to celebrate the defeat of Majin Buu and, of course, he's not here!
!Hi, guys! Sorry, I'm late!
!I can't believe you, Goku! When you were dead, at least you had an excuse to not be around!Where have you been? We've all been worried sick!
!Well, I was helping these pterodactyls protect their eggs. You should have seen them!So helpless and fragile!
!You are so lame, Goku! But at least you were protecting some helpless babies...
C'mon, everyone! The food is ready!
Hey, Vegeta! Come over here and join the party, will ya?
If you insist, Kakarot.
And so, finally Goku and his friends could relax and enjoy themselves, without the weight of the world on their shoulders.
Ten years passed since that fateful day when Goku defeated Majin Buu. Many things have changed.
Videl and Gohan have married and had a child. A young girl named Pan...
Grandpa!!!! I'm going to enter the World Tournament!
That's great!
Pan is entering the tournament? But there isn't a Junior Division anymore!She's going to have to fight with adults!
Don't worry! Pan could hold her own in any division!
Trunks and Goten have grown up.
My dad's making me enter the tournament. I actually had a date for tomorrow night... Until he made me cancel it that is!
My dad is making me enter the tournament too!He threatened to take away my allowance if I didn't enter!
And, of course, Hercule and Buu are still good friends!
So here's the plan, Buu! You're going to beat all of the challengers and then lose to me in the finals!
Okay!
One of these days I'm going to let you win and you can be the champion! How's that sound?
Okay!
Oh, hey, Goku! How ya doin', buddy?
Hey, Grandpa, don't forget about me!
Pan! How could I forget about you? You're my favorite little girl in the world! Are you here to cheer your grandpa on?
No! I'm here to fight in the tournament!
What???
Don't worry! She'll be fine. She can handle herself alright. We're all going to fight! It's going to be fun!
All of you? Oh, no!
Don't worry... If one of us makes it to the finals, we'll let you take the victory, okay?
Really? You'd do that for me?
Of course! Why not? But someone else might make it to the finals... You never know!

nodes.text: Goku? Is that really you?
Yes! Please, tell me what's happened!
Alright. While you were off fighting Vegeta...
...and we're still unsure where the Supreme Kai is, even though we can sense he's still alive.
I see... And Gohan and Vegeta are... Gone? What kind of monster are we dealing with?
Majin Buu's power level continues to increase... If we can't stop him from destroying the Earth, there will be nothing to prevent him from destroying all life in the universe!
Don't be such a downer Piccolo! We have nothing to worry about now that Goku's here. Am I right?
No... It's impossible. I can't beat him alone. He's simply too powerful.
When Vegeta and I fought, we were evenly matched. He gave everything he had and he still couldn't beat that thing. If only Vegeta hadn't been so arrogant thinking he could beat Buu by himself...
Even if we had an army of Super Saiyans, it wouldn't have made any difference.
True... But I was about to say that if Vegeta or Gohan were still around, we could have done a fusion!
You mean like Piccolo and Kami did?

Sort of... While I was in the Other World, I met a race of aliens called the Metamor. They taught me the Metamorese art of fusion! It's an ancient art that can be performed between two people of similar size and physical ability. However, it's only temporary, but the exponential increase in power might have been enough to defeat Buu... But it's too late for that now.
What about the young ones? Goten and Trunks are about the same size. Could they do a fusion?

That just might work Mr. Popo! The boys are certainly very strong, but I'm not sure if they're strong enough to perform a fusion yet... Sure they're both Super Saiyans, which is extraordinary for their age, but-
Don't worry about us Dad! We're plenty strong!
Yeah... We could probably beat up Buu without this fusion!

Now boys... Let's not be rash. You guys are strong. Real strong. But there's more to fighting than strength. I have an idea. If we can defeat Buu, we're going to need the  Dragon Balls  to wish back all his victims. I want you boys to search for the Dragon Balls and bring them back here. It'll be a great training exercise and it builds character!
We should get the  Dragon Radar  from my Mom! We'll find the Dragon Balls in no time!
You are now playing as Goten.
Journal Entry:  Get the Dragon Radar from Bulma and find the Dragon Balls .

nodes.text: Now, will someone tell me where Gohan is?
And what about Vegeta? Where is he?
!What I have to tell you isn't easy for me to say right now, but... Gohan and Vegeta are dead.
Vegeta... Gone?
This can't be... That couldn't happen to my dad.
No!!! Gohan, how could this happen?
My brother can't be gone!
No... Gohan is still alive! I know it!
!Majin Buu destroyed them both. I can't sense their life-forces anymore. That means they've passed on.
We haven't even found a body yet and you just stand around here acting like we've already buried him!I refuse to believe it!
It's never easy dealing with the loss of loved ones. But there's no time for mourning. We need to take action. Even in this place we aren't going to be safe for long.
Attention, people of Earth!
Huh? What the...?
!Babidi is telepathically communicating with the entire planet!

I am the omnipotent wizard Babidi, son of the great wizard Bibidi. I'm so sorry to bother you, especially if you're having an otherwise pleasant day. I too, know what it's like to be pestered while having fun. You see, earlier today, three nuisances did just that! Now I'm simply looking to return the favor.
These are the three cretins I am looking for.

Get a good look at them! They are to blame for any and all destruction that may come your way! Come out you little cowards! I've got a preview of what's in store for you if you refuse to show your faces!
This is my faithful servant Majin Buu, the heavyweight champion of the universe! He may not seem like much, but he's actually unstoppable.

!Now do you see this city? It looks like a lovely place to live, doesn't it? Well now, the citizens of this delightful burg are going to get a sneak preview of the high cost of your cowardice, while you look on from your hiding place! Let the fun begin, Majin Buu!

!This is but a small taste of what will happen if you don't surrender. If those three meddlers don't show themselves, Majin Buu will destroy everyone on the entire planet! I think I've made my point. If anyone knows where those three are, you'd better tell me. You have five days to tell me where they are hiding, or else all of the people on the planet will be annihilated!
Curse that demented wizard!
So those are the ones who took Vegeta and Gohan away from us...
Yes... Vegeta... Gohan... All those people... And unless we do something, the list will keep growing.
I can't allow that to happen! I'll show myself!
!No! That won't help anyone and you know it. Babidi's going to wipe out everyone no matter what you do. Stay here and help me teach Goten and Trunks the fusion technique.
!Alright... I'll stay.
!Okay Goten and Trunks! We have a lot of work to do! You'll have to learn some new skills really fast. You got that?

nodes.text: Okay. The first thing you need to know is that the fusion only lasts for five minutes. Once that time is up, your bodies will separate and you guys will turn back to normal.
Five minutes? That's not going to be long enough for this kind of fight!
As long as the fusion is done correctly, five minutes is all they will need. The technique is really that powerful.
Trunks, what's wrong?
We want to know! You're supposed to be the strongest guy in the universe or something.So why weren't you there? Why didn't you save Gohan or my dad?
I'm sorry, Trunks.
You're sorry? You could have helped! But instead my dad is gone!
Gohan always told me you could do anything! So why didn't you save him from the Buu monster?
Don't just stand there, Goku. Say something.
I really don't know what to say... I wish I was the strongest man in the universe. But I'm not. I can't beat Majin Buu.
But with this fusion technique, I know that the two of you can! If you trust me, we can still get that monster for all the terrible things he's done! Are you with me?
I'm game.
Okay.
The fusion technique is kind of like a dance. You have to perform a specific series of movements and your timing has to be right on. It's not that difficult to do really... It looks like this.
Hmmm... Goku... Isn't that dance a bit...
A bit what, Piccolo?
Never mind.
Alright, why don't you two try this out?
You are now playing as Goten.Perform the  Fusion Dance  by following the  on-screen icons .
Your timing was off! Why don't you try it again?
That was great! Now I want you to keep practicing! Let's see if you can do it right 5 times in a row!

nodes.text: !What a mess! I wish someone would turn those cowards in to Babidi! Wait a second... That boy was Trunks! He was the one who cheated and beat my Idasa in the junior tournament! People all over the world are dying because that little hooligan won't show his face. If I knew where he was at, I would tell Babidi myself!
!I know, Mom! He lives in West City at the Capsule Corporation!
!Are you sure about that? Then we should concentrate and try to contact Babidi with our minds!
!Babidi! Can you hear me?
Who is this?

!Why I'm the head of the PTA at my son's school so it's my duty to do what I can to help end this whole silly situation. I think you should know that one of those boys you're looking for is named Trunks and he lives at the Capsule Corporation! Now you can go there and give that little brat what he has coming to him! That dirty little Trunks cheated at the tournament today, and he stole the title--
SHUT UP!!!!!!
I thank you for sending me that wonderful information, but if I hear your annoying screech of a voice again, I will kill you!

Attention, Earthlings! So sorry to bother you again, but I've acquired a bit of information that I just couldn't wait to pass along. You see I now know that one of the meddlers I'm looking for is named Trunks. I'm very eager to meet you, but since you won't come to me, I am going to have to come to you. I also know now that you live in a place called Capsule Corporation. I hope you're there when I arrive, or your family and friends will pay the price!
Did you hear that?
Someone told those creeps where we live! I can't let them go there! My grandpa and grandma are still there!
Oh, no! My mother and father are going to be killed! They refuse to leave the house, even if Majin Buu comes. They're so stubborn!
Don't worry too much. We can bring them back with the Dragon Balls!
But the Dragon Radar is back at Capsule Corp! If Buu destroys the Dragon Radar, we won't be able to find the Dragon Balls!
Yeah, that would pose a problem...
Trunks, I need you to go to Capsule Corp and get the Dragon Radar. And while you do that, I'll get in front of Babidi and Buu to slow them down!
Goten, stay here and hold down the fort for me, okay?
You are now playing as Goku.Journal Entry: Stop Babidi and Majin Buu from getting to  Capsule Corporation .

nodes.text: Goku, are you okay?
Yeah. It's just that Super Saiyan 3 took a lot out of me. But I'll be okay.
I brought the Dragon Radar, sir!
Good job, soldier! Mission accomplished!
Thank you, sir! When can we do the fusion? You guys didn't start without me did you?
Of course, we didn't! It takes two to fuse. We need to start training again right away! The fate of the world depends on your cooperation. We don't have much time!
Actually, you only have thirty minutes!
Baba, how did you get here?
THIRTY MINUTES???Is that all the time I've got? Quick! Let's go!!!
Alright, that's good! Keep going!
What's wrong, Trunks?
I'm sorry. But this fusion seems lame!
What? You think it's lame? Fusion is anything but lame! The Metamorese who taught me this were some of the strongest fighters in the universe!
Okay... But first can you show me how to turn into Super Saiyan 3?
Yeah! Me too, Dad! I want to learn!
If we both become Super Saiyan 3, we can beat Buu easy! It'll be way better than this boring ol' fusion!
You can't! The only way you're going to beat Majin Buu is by fusing together.
Oh, all right...
Oh, what the heck! I'll show you Super Saiyan 3 just one time!
Yay!
Cool!
But you have to promise me that you'll really learn how to fuse!
What are you doing, Goku? You're going to run out of time!
I'm already out of time, Piccolo.
Okay, boys. Listen up! First thing you do is turn Super Saiyan.
Next, look for the energy deep inside you. Push as hard as you can to find it, and then tap into that energy...
And you become Super Saiyan 3!
Awesome!
Dad! What's wrong?
His time is up. That little stunt he just pulled drained the last grains of sand from the hourglass.
I gotta go now?
Piccolo! Pick up where I left off, okay? I'm putting all my trust into you.
Trunks and Goten, I know you will show Piccolo the same respect and dedication that you've shown me. He's in charge now!
Goku, no! How can I say goodbye to you when Gohan has left me too?

strings: Goku, are you okay?
Yeah. It's just that Super Saiyan 3 took a lot out of me. But I'll be okay.
I brought the Dragon Radar, sir!
Good job, soldier! Mission accomplished!
Thank you, sir! When can we do the fusion? You guys didn't start without me did you?
Of course, we didn't! It takes two to fuse. We need to start training again right away! The fate of the world depends on your cooperation. We don't have much time!
Actually, you only have thirty minutes!
Baba, how did you get here?
THIRTY MINUTES???Is that all the time I've got? Quick! Let's go!!!
Alright, that's good! Keep going!
What's wrong, Trunks?
I'm sorry. But this fusion seems lame!
What? You think it's lame? Fusion is anything but lame! The Metamorese who taught me this were some of the strongest fighters in the universe!
Okay... But first can you show me how to turn into Super Saiyan 3?
Yeah! Me too, Dad! I want to learn!
If we both become Super Saiyan 3, we can beat Buu easy! It'll be way better than this boring ol' fusion!
You can't! The only way you're going to beat Majin Buu is by fusing together.
Oh, all right...
Oh, what the heck! I'll show you Super Saiyan 3 just one time!
Yay!
Cool!
But you have to promise me that you'll really learn how to fuse!
What are you doing, Goku? You're going to run out of time!
I'm already out of time, Piccolo.
Okay, boys. Listen up! First thing you do is turn Super Saiyan.
Next, look for the energy deep inside you. Push as hard as you can to find it, and then tap into that energy...
And you become Super Saiyan 3!
Awesome!
Dad! What's wrong?
His time is up. That little stunt he just pulled drained the last grains of sand from the hourglass.
I gotta go now?
Piccolo! Pick up where I left off, okay? I'm putting all my trust into you.

nodes.text: Wow! He's still alive!
Did you do it, Gotenks?
Did you beat Majin Buu?
Well... Not exactly. He's tougher than I thought.

Serves you right! You fool! You could have blown the only chance we had to win! From now on we do things my way! Tomorrow you will fight Buu as a Super Saiyan and until then we train? You got that, Trunkten?
Actually... His name is Gotenks!
His name is MUD as far as I'm concerned!
What were you thinking taking on Majin Buu like that? No fighter has ever won a fight using his fists alone! All battles are won before they are fought. Do you know how?
By planning?
That's right!
When my dad fought Majin Buu, he lost because he didn't plan, right? And then I went off and did the same thing.
That's the last time. From now on I'm going to do things right! If we're going to beat this guy, I'm going to have to be smarter than my dad ever was.
That's the right attitude to have.

nodes.text: Majin Buu's transformation is troubling! It's brought his power to a level that I can't even measure!Not only that... His dark side won the battle. He's become almost pure evil!
But we can still beat him, right?
It's hard to say... Gotenks should be able to put up a good fight...
Oh, no!
What is it?
Majin Buu is here!
I've found you finally! I was promised a good fight! Produce the challenger! Which one of you is it?
Was it you?
Who me? No! It wasn't me!
Then who is it?
He's not here! I mean... He can't fight right now! He's sleeping!
Well I guess you'll just have to go wake him up then, won't you?
But he needs his rest! He could fight, but wouldn't you rather fight him at his maximum? You want a real challenge, don't you?
I don't want to wait. Waiting isn't fun.
But the promise was made for two days! We still have a day left!
But I'm here now!
Listen. All we're asking for is a day!
No.
We just need a little time! Please! At least just give me one hour!
An hour? What is an hour?
See this?
When the last grain of sand in this hour glass reaches the bottom, an hour will be over.
No way!
Why not? It's just an hour! No big deal! Unless you're scared. Is that it?
Loud mouth girl! Say goodbye!
Wait, Buu! That's Hercule's daughter!
Hercule?
Yes... It's true... Very well. I will wait for one hour! And then I will kill you all.

!The Hyperbolic Time Chamber is right through this door guys. For every minute in normal time, you can train six hours in the hyperbolic time chamber! You understand how important this is right?So don't fool around in there!
!Got it!
!Good luck, guys!
Wow! Look at how big it is in here!
Whoa... My body feels kind of weird and heavy...

What is it?
Let's fuse! I want to try something out!
That's enough! No more waiting.
But it's only been thirty minutes!
I'm done waiting! Come out! Do you hear me!
Alright! I'll take you to him! This way!
Why doesn't Piccolo call Goten and Trunks out here? He isn't taking Buu into the Hyperbolic Time Chamber, is he?

If they fight Majin Buu inside the Hyperbolic Time Chamber and the entrance is destroyed, then that dimension will be closed off from this one. Even if Trunks and Goten lose, Earth might still be saved.
But if the entrance is destroyed, won't they be trapped inside along with Buu?
Forever.
Man... That was a work out! Now there's no way he can beat us! But there's a still a problem of time...
Yeah, but if we try jumping to the new super level as soon as we fuse, then we'll beat him in like four minutes!

But it's stupid to do it so fast! Warriors drag out their fights as long as possible! Here's what I'm thinking... We start off with normal fusion; spend as much time as we can playing around. Then we make it look like we can't take it any more and that's when we spring it on him! It'll be the kind of move that people never forget!
Goten! Trunks! Can you hear me?

Don't be frightened. It's me, Piccolo. Listen carefully. The two of you are going to have to fight Majin Buu a lot sooner than expected. He's on his way as I speak! I've tried to hold him off as long as possible, but he just won't listen to reason. Fuse into Gotenks as quick as you can!
Nice to see you again, Majin Buu.
Ah, yes... There's my fighter... too bad no one else is around to witness your final hour.
Final hour? That's pretty clever. You're in for a big surprise when my fists start flying.

They're in me.
What? You mean you ate them?
Yes. Everyone. They were very tasty.
No!!!! You'll pay for each one!

nodes.text: And so the tournament began. Things started out uneventful, with Krillin easily defeating Pintar.
But when Piccolo stepped out into the ring with the mysterious Mr. Shin, things began to get interesting...

This is the first year Shin has participated in the tournament.  He's a man of few words, so we know very little about him.  And that could spell trouble for our other competitor... Majunior!  Someone who, if I remember correctly, came close to turning this arena into rubble the last time he was here! This time try to leave the stadium intact, okay?
This could be interesting... Don't you think, Piccolo?
(How does he know my name? And what is this strange energy I'm feeling?)
Alright, fighters! Let the second match begin!
(Why can't I focus my power?)
Hey, guys... Uhh... The match has started. You can throw punches now!
(Why am I holding back like this?  I've never even met him before today!  And yet, there's something about him... that reminds me...)
Well, martial arts fans, it looks like what we have here is a good old fashioned stand off.
No... It couldn't be... You're not... Why would he be here?
I promise you'll know soon. But for now, let's just enjoy our little match.
No. I'm sorry. I can't.
Does this mean you're forfeiting the match?
Yes, it does.
You heard it, folks! Majunior has withdrawn from the match! This makes Shin the winner by default!
#What's wrong, Piccolo?
#Is he really that strong?
#Yes. Stronger than you can imagine.
#Oh, great... And I'm going to have to fight this guy next.
#Excuse me.
#What is it?
#Forgive me if I'm mistaken, but I have to ask you... Are you the Grand Kai?
#No. Sorry. I am not.
#I'll tell you who he is... the Supreme Kai!
#Supreme Kai!?!? I've always suspected that there was an even greater Kai above the Grand Kai, but until now, I never knew for sure. What are you doing on Earth?
#That will all become clear. For now, please keep this information to yourself.

nodes.text: All right! It's time to start the ball rolling! The fighters will now draw lots to see who will be matched up with whom in the first round of the finals!
You're up to something, aren't you, Kakarot.
What do you mean?
Tell me the real reason you entered this tournament!
Oh... Well... There's this one guy who signed up for the tournament and I really want to fight him.He's good. Real good.
What? I would have sensed someone that powerful. There's no one here like that.
Well it just so happens he's very shrewd. He's surpressing his energy!But somehow I know he's strong.
I don't believe it! Is he an alien or something?
Nope... He's an Earthling!
An Earthling? Is he some sort of Android or something?
Nope. He's one hundred percent home grown human being.
So which one is he, Kakarot?
I'm not telling!
Now, then! As I call your name please come up and draw a number! The first fighter is Goten!
Hey, Buu! I'd like you to do me a little favor. But you're going to have to use your magic. I want you to change the lot numbers so that I can fight a certain guy. Will you do it?
Okay! Buu do!
It's not like you to break the rules, Kakarot!
I know... But I have to make sure I fight this guy in the first round. That way we'll both be at our full strength and it'll be a fair match.
Next up! Goku!
Okay, Buu! I want you to make me pick number three. All right?
Okay!
Goku is number three!
Okay... Next up is Uub!
Okay, Buu! I want you to make this one number four.
Okay!
No way! This can't be him! He's just a kid!
Don't be deceived by his appearance. He's the one all right!
How could you possibly know that? I don't understand!

Well, it's strange... But right before I destroyed the evil Buu, I made a request. I asked him to come back as a good person so we could fight together. And apparently King Yemma heard my request and decided to make it happen!
Wait... You're saying... This boy is Buu???

Yes... Somehow I just know. I can feel it... There are some other clues... Look at his name. Uub. It's Buu spelled backwards! Not only that, Uub is ten years old... It was ten years ago that we defeated Buu!
Uub is Buu reincarnated!
And so Goku got his wish.

nodes.text: You can't fly, can you? You need a Master who can teach you that sort of thing! You're strong. Real strong! But you don't quite know how to control your energy yet. I'll bet you've never fought in a fight like this before, have you?
No, I haven't.
How about this! From now on, I'm going to live in your village and teach you how to fight! Does that sound good?
Yes, of course! But... I come from a poor family. I spend my days working with my Father. Fighting is fun, but there just isn't much time for it! My family can't afford to let me fight all the time!
Oh, I see! Well, we're just going to have to find a sponsor for you! I know just the guy... Hercule has more money than he has body hair! Don't worry! You'll be covered!I'll be right back!
Dad, what's going on?

Hey, guys... Just wanted to let you all know that I'm going to live in Uub's village so I can train him! I don't know how many years it's going to take... But I promise I'll visit you guys! Thanks for understanding!
But I don't understand! You're leaving me again?
Don't worry! I'll come and visit. Hey, Vegeta! Are you upset we didn't get to fight today?
Don't worry about it, Kakarot. This arena is too small. When we fight, we're going to need a whole planet for an arena!
Bye, everyone!

Young Uub has been taken in by the greatest Martial Arts master in the Universe: Goku, the orphan who fell from the stars to become the savior of mankind! As the two set off on a new adventure, one thing is for certain... as long as Goku lives, peace and prosperity shall reign!

nodes.text: Oh, great! What now?
It seems Babidi has decided to transport us again.
What the... Four people just appeared out of nowhere! How bizarre! This is highly unusual!Four strange fighters have appeared in the arena, but the championship has already been decided!
Yeah! I won this tournament fair and square!
Excuse me gentlemen! The championship has already been completed! There's always next year...
That's okay. We're just here for a little exhibition match!
Vegeta! This is your new master Babidi speaking! It's time for you to have a little fun!You can start by killing your friends!
I won't. I am only here to fight Kakarot. The others... They're nothing!
A defiant one, aren't you? You'll come around eventually...
It's time, Kakarot.
Vegeta! No! We're on the same side! They're making you do this. Fight it!
No one is making me do anything, Kakarot.
This is terrible! All those people!
Vegeta... How could you? The Vegeta I know would have never done this!
So how about it, Kakarot? Are you ready to fight me now?
This isn't the time, Vegeta!
Oh, you'll fight me, Kakarot. Unless you'd like another part of the stadium to be "remodeled".
Vegeta... Certainly you didn't do that on purpose? How sad.I didn't think you were weak enough to be controlled. How can you let yourself be a slave?
Tell me... Is it slavery when you get what you want?
Stop this! Both of you!
Stand aside, boy. This doesn't concern you. It's between me and your circus clown of a father!
Circus clown? That's a new one.
Goku! No! If you fight him, you'll be doing precisely what Babidi wants! With every injury Vegeta causes, more energy will be sent back to the spaceship and Buu will be revived!
Tell me, Vegeta! I know Babidi has been giving you orders. Is this one of them?Are you trying to fight me because of him or is this the same old story between you and me? Which one?
You know as well as I do, Kakarot, that at the end of this day, you'll be back in the land of the dead.I'm not letting this opportunity slip by.
Who are you people?Don't you see that the fate of the universe is more important than your meaningless squabble?

What do you know of meaningless? Spend most of your life ruled by another...Watch your race dwindle to a handful. And then tell me, what has meaning other than your own strength?I have the blood of a Saiyan prince! He is nothing but a clown!Yet I have had to watch him surpass me time and time again!He's even saved my life as if I were a helpless child...He's stolen my honor and this debt must be paid!
Babidi! I know that you can hear me! Transport us to a place away from people!If you give me that, I'll fight Vegeta!
So be it! If you truly think you've made the right decision, then you'll have to get around me to do it!
I don't want to have to hurt you, Supreme Kai...
Dad! What are you doing?
Fine... Do what you want. I can't stop you.

nodes.text: !Hey! Come look at this!
!It looks like the ground here has been disturbed recently. Like it's been dug up or something...And there's Spopovich and Yamu!
!Of course! It's so obvious now! That's why we couldn't find his spaceship.He buried the whole thing underground!
!Look! Someone's coming out of the ship!
!Dabura! That cursed wizard managed to ensnare the king of the demons!
!Which one is Dabura?

!The tall one. He's the king of the demon world. It's a shadow world on the other side of this one, like two sides of the same coin. You may be the strongest in this world,but in his dark world of demons, Dabura is the strongest by far!
!And that little guy? Is he Babidi?

!Yes, he is. Don't underestimate him because of his size. He's the most dangerous of them all.His magic is able to keep a being like Dabura under his control.So just imagine the kind of horror he could inflict upon this world!
!If he's so strong, what's going to keep us from falling under his spell?

!He seeks out the evil desires in a person's heart. Once he discovers them, he manipulates them and enhances them, and ultimately controls them. That is how Dabura was captured. That is why only the pure of heart, like us, have a chance of fighting him.
!Well, that works for most of us.But what about Piccolo? He hasn't always been one of the good guys, you know!
!Grrrrrr...
So boys... what have you brought me?
!It's the energy you asked for master. It's stored inside.
You've done well. We are now one step closer to achieving our goal. It's a shame that your business with me is finished, because I'm afraid I have no more use for you!
Too bad... I really liked them. Wonderful isn't it? Before he perished, did you see the look of fear in his eyes? It pleases me to no end to see how easily humans are frightened.
And those were only two of them. There are millions left to torment!
Oh and there's something else...
Yes, master?
It appears we have some company. Spopovich and Yamu were followed.

!Indeed. The fools believe they are well hidden. There are seven of them in all.One of them is the Supreme Kai. And three of them possess an enormous level of energy that we can use.It will go a long way towards reviving Majin Buu.
More than that! In these three alone, we'll find more than enough energy to suit our purposes!How marvelous!
!Babidi is going back inside. But Dabura is staying behind.
!Oh, no...
!He knows we're here!
Now! Let's begin!
!Oh, no! I should have warned them! It's one of Dabura's special powers. Anything he spits on turns to stone! But don't worry... If we can defeat Dabura, they'll turn back to normal!
I leave you one chance to run! Take it, unless you want to end up like your friends!
!What are we waiting for! After him!
!No! They're counting on the fact that you'll charge into their spaceship to stop them.It's safer for all of us if you wait out here!
!Sorry! But we just can't do that.
!But don't you understand? It's a trap!
!Patience has never been our strongest virtue...
!We have to defeat Dabura and turn our friends back to normal!
Journal Entry:  Enter Babidi's ship  to  defeat Dabura !

nodes.text: !This is too easy... I figured there would be a welcoming committee... But there's barely anyone here.
!So you couldn't resist the challenge of a good fight.
You have no idea what you've gotten yourselves into. Once inside this ship there is no way out.Our only hope of escape now is to destroy Babidi.
!Well, that's what we came here to do, isn't it?
!I'll solve all of our problems right now and blow this place into oblivion!
!No you won't! The sudden shock could accidentally set Majin Buu free!The degree to which you've underestimated him is astounding! Don't you understand?
Welcome fellow warriors! You've arrived at the end of Stage One!
!Uh... What's Stage One?

Master Babidi is at the bottom of this ship. We are currently at the top level of the ship, also known as Stage One. And there's no way of getting down to him,unless you beat the Boss Warrior that appears at the end of each stage!But don't worry about that, because none of you will make it out of Stage One alive!
!Alright, who gets to fight first?
I'll fight him! I want to get this over with as quickly as possible.
!Wait! You don't intend to fight by yourself do you?
Of course, I do! What other way is there?

Do you not realize that as I destroy you, every ounce of energy you have will be absorbed by this ship and channeled directly into Majin Buu! You will not survive this battle. With Pui Pui, death is a certainty!
This guy is really annoying. I've had enough of your talk. Why don't you stop talking and start fighting?
I think you fail to understand me... Do you realize where I'm from? I'm from the planet Zoon.It's a place where the gravity is ten times that of Earth! That gives me the advantage!
Maybe if it was 500 times the gravity of Earth, you would have an advantage.I was training in 450 times gravity just the other day and I didn't break a sweat!
You're bluffing!
Try me!

Roooooaaaaaarrrrr!!!!!!
Boy, he sure is ugly!
Yummy! Which one of you do I eat first?
This is the Stage Two Boss? Why do I have to fight this one? Sure he's big, but he looks kinda dumb to me...
Huh?
Be careful! I know this monster! His name is Yakon! He's one of the most feared monsters in the universe!

nodes.text: The end of Stage Three... You'd think that Babidi would vary up the décor a bit.Everything looks the same!
Hopefully, the fighter on this stage will be worth it, Gohan. It's your turn next!
This is maddening! You guys are acting like this is a game! We've been lucky so far, but I think from now on we should all fight together, instead of fighting one at a time.
Nah... Don't worry so much, Supreme Kai! Whatever comes through that door,Gohan will be able to handle it. Besides, it would be unfair to Gohan. Vegeta and I got our turns.This is Gohan's turn.
Yeah! Nothing to worry about!
Boy, Gohan... I can't wait to see how you've progressed over the years.You must be twice as strong as you were when you beat Cell!
Well... Actually I'm not quite as strong as I was back then...

Yes. Gohan's been far too busy going to school and going out on dates for any serious training!Of course, I could be wrong... Maybe he's been training between classes or in P.E. class or something...
!Dabura! I can't believe Babidi would send him so soon! It's only Stage Three!
Beating Yakon and advancing to Stage Three is far beyond what any other mortal has managed to do.It was quite unexpected... But now you must face me! Which means you will progress no further!
!Heh... Your boss must be pretty nervous if he sent out his number one guy!
Let's dispense with the idle talk. I'd prefer you all just attack! All of you together!
!Wait a second! It's my turn to fight. I'll fight you alone!
Impudent fool... Very well... As you wish.

nodes.text: I can't take this anymore! This is ridiculous. Why are we subjecting ourselves to this? Gohan is nowhere near as strong as he was when he fought Cell. Call him down, Kakarot! I'll take care of this myself!
Just give him time. He's not doing that bad. He's hanging in there!

Spare me! Dabura is just toying with him. We're wasting time here. I could end this in five minutes if I wanted to. I'm not here to help you guys create special father-son memories! I'm here to win!Let's knock off all this sentimental rubbish! I'm the one that should be fighting, not him!
Hmmm... Master, are you there?
Yes, Dabura. What is it?
Please bring us back to the ship immediately. I have made an important discovery.It's something I'm sure you'll want to know.
!Huh? What are we doing back here?
!I don't know.  I guess they wanted us back on the ship for some reason.
!Why?
Hey! What's going on? Are you giving up or something?

Oh, no! It's just a brief intermission. Relax! We just need to rework our strategy!It seems we've found a new recruit. The perfect warrior capable of handling all of you!So just take a rest while we get him ready!
What is he talking about? They don't have a warrior stronger than Dabura. What's going on here?
What are they up to?

Arrghh!!! This whole thing would be over by now if it wasn't for you! I hope you're proud of yourself!You disgraced all of us with your pitiful performance! Piccolo and Krillin were turned to stone.That's because they're weaklings! Is that the kind of fate you want for yourself?Do you want to be a GARDEN STATUE? If they're lucky, someone will make a birdbath out of them!
Maybe you're right... Maybe if you had fought Dabura, Krillin and Piccolo would be okay right now...
You do-gooders aren't going to hold me back any longer! I'm taking control of this operation!And for starters, I'm going to blow this ship to Kingdom Come!!!
Do you understand what you're saying? If you do that, you'll revive Buu and if Buu is revived this planet is finished! All living things will be exterminated!
What happens to this planet is none of my concern!The strongest will find a way to survive and the weaklings will perish!
Wait... What kind of person are you? Maybe Dabura wasn't bluffing...What if the "perfect warrior" Dabura was talking about was right here among us?Oh, no... Don't tell me...
Vegeta...is...the one!!!!
ARRRRRGGGGHHHHH!!!!!!
Vegeta! What's wrong?
Babidi is trying to take over his mind and enslave him so that he'll do whatever Babidi wants him to do!Don't let him take you, Vegeta! Let go of the past! Don't think of it! Be innocent and clear!
How can you say that? I'm not innocent!
But you made the effort to change! Vegeta! You have to fight!
Fight it, Vegeta! You have to stop it before it's too late!
His power is increasing... It's monstrous! You have to stop this, Vegeta!
It's too late!
Ha... Ha... Ha...
Look at his forehead! It has an "M" on it, like Dabura!
It's Babidi's symbol. He's working for Babidi now.
What's the matter? You all look frightened! Hahahaha!

nodes.text: !This is it, Gohan. This is what we're here to find!
!Majin Buu is inside that thing?
!Yes! And we must act quickly! If we combine our powers, we might have a chance to destroy it!
Well, hello! I'm glad you could join us!
!We've come to stop you, Babidi!
Like you did my father? I'm afraid it won't be that easy Supreme Kai... Unlike my father, I have an eye for talent! Am I right, Dabura?
That's right, master.
!Listen, Gohan, we have to strike now before Buu reaches his full power! Hold nothing back!
Wait, Kai... Before you do anything... Let's take this outside! It seems a bit cramped in here...
Papparapa!!!!

nodes.text: I suppose there's no point resisting what cannot be helped. We will have to continue our efforts with a new strategy. While you two fight, Gohan and I will continue our assault upon Babidi and Dabura.
Oh, no you don't! Vegeta! Destroy the Supreme Kai!
I refuse!
What???
Your business with the Supreme Kai... It means nothing to me. Kakarot is my only objective.
I'm serious, Vegeta! I command you to destroy the Supreme Kai!
Get out of my head! I already told you! I will not be distracted from my goal! You may have invaded my mind and body... But there is one thing a Saiyan always keeps...
HIS PRIDE!!!!

What? This has never happened before! Since when can the possessed say "no" to the possessor? No matter... Have your fight with Goku. The result will be the same, and Majin Buu will finally be released!
Let's go. I'm ready now!
That's good to hear, Kakarot. Now let us begin!

nodes.text: Dabura! Feel free to dispose of these fools any way you like! Perhaps you could turn them to stone...
No, I have something far more painful in mind!
What's this? Could it be? But so soon! I don't believe it!
!Oh, no! We're too late!
Master Babidi! What's happening?
Majin Buu is at full power!
!I don't understand... Goku's energy alone couldn't...
!Dad... Dad must be fighting at a level beyond Super Saiyan! Dad and Vegeta both! And when two powers like that collide with that much energy...
!No! How could I let this happen?

I'm amazed, Vegeta! These last seven years in the Other World I've been through the most intense training sessions... But we're still completely even. I guess this whole time you've been pushing yourself even harder than I have.

It's true. I've pushed myself to the edge of my limits and beyond, but you've been born with a natural talent far beyond my own. No amount of training could have closed the gap between us. Today as you fought Yakon, I realized that no matter how hard I tried I would never be able to catch up to you. So that's when I secretly made up my mind...
You mean... You fool! You deliberately let yourself fall under Babidi's spell!

Yes. I saw the power of Babidi's magic as I watched that fighter Spopovich. I saw what his magic had done, and realized that it could also do the same thing for me! I have to say I'm quite pleased with the results, even if they do come at a price! I'd say the end more than justifies the means!
Vegeta, I don't understand. You've never allowed anyone to help you before in your life. Why start now?

Because I wanted Babidi to reawaken the evil in my heart... I wanted him to return me to the way I was before! I was the perfect warrior... But slowly I started to become one of you! My quest for greatness gradually gave way to this life of mediocrity. I awoke one day to find that I had settled down and formed a family. I had even grown quite fond of them. That's why I needed Babidi! I needed him to set me free!
Do you seriously believe what you're saying?
Enough talk, Kakarot! We finish this now!

nodes.text: !We have to get out of here before Buu hatches! Run!
!No!!!! I have to try to stop it from hatching.
!Fool! We need you alive, Gohan!
!I have to do this. Now step aside!
What are you doing?
!Ka!Me!Ha!Me!HAAAAAAAAA!!!!!!!
It's empty! How can this be?
!Unbelievable! Gohan! You did it!
!You made a fatal mistake, Babidi, just like your father! You were fooled by overconfidence and you underestimated your opponents! Now the story of Buu finally comes to an end!
Don't let that fool discourage you, Babidi. Even without Buu we can continue our plan.
Don't you understand? Without Buu, there is no plan!
!Do you realize what this means, Gohan? All we have to do is take care of Babidi and Dabura, and everything will be back to normal.
!No... My attack wasn't strong enough to destroy the energy I felt in that egg. Something came out of that egg...
!But I don't sense anything...
!It's there in the sky!
Tell me master. Is this Majin Buu?
To tell you the truth... I'm not sure! I've never seen him before. The only one who has would be that annoying Kai over there!
!What's the deal, Supreme Kai? Is this the guy you're so afraid of?
!Yes! That's Bibidi's creation no doubt! I could never forget that disgusting creature's face!
Look at my face, Buu. I'm the son of Bibidi, your creator! You can call me Master! If it wasn't for me, you would still be trapped inside of that ball forever!
Don't turn your back to me! What is the meaning of this? I command you to turn around!
This creature is nothing but a fool! I had great hopes for Majin Buu, but this deformed thing is nothing but a waste!
Grrrrr!!!!
What's wrong? Do you have a problem with what I just said?
Pow! Pow! Pow! Ow! Ow! Ow!
Huh?
Heh... I guess Babidi made a real mess of reviving Majin Buu. He's like an infant!

nodes.text: I'm sorry, Gohan. This is it... It's all over. I was too confident that I could stop Babidi before Buu was revived. But it's too late now.
Listen to yourself! We're not dead yet!
That's what you think! Buu! Eliminate these two! And be quick about it!
Buuuuuuuuu!!!!! Buu make you dead!
Finish him, Buu!!!!!
Dabura, you insolent fool! What do you think you're doing?

Babidi! I beg you! This Majin Buu creature is far too powerful to be controlled! If he is allowed to reach his full power it will only be a matter of time before he destroys you! Make the best decision of your life and help me crush him while we can!
Dabura, are you insane? Buu is my life's ambition! How dare you harm him!
Now I eat you! You turn into cupcake!

nodes.text: Trunks and Goten! What are you doing here?
My dad! I have to help him!
Stay where you are! You'll just cause Vegeta more pain if you get involved!
No!
Trunks! Wait up!
No, Goten! You'll just make things worse!
Let me go! Trunks needs my help! If I were Gohan you'd let me go!
Dad? Are you okay?
Is he alive?
Of course, he is! My mom told me once that my dad was prince of all of the Saiyans!
Wow! Your dad is a prince?
That's right. And how could a prince lose to some stupid monster?
*cough* Trunks... My son...
Who are you?
I'm the one who is going to make you writhe in agony like the worm you are!
How dare you speak to me like that? Don't you know who I am? I'll have Buu destroy you!
Sure! Call your monster! So he can watch you die!
Wait! Don't you realize that if I'm dead, no one will be able to control Buu? He'll destroy everything!
Don't you already plan on doing that anyway? So what would the difference be?
Goodbye, wizard!
Listen... Son... I want you to take good care of your Mother.
Why do you say that? Are you going somewhere?
I want both of you boys to get away from here. I will fight Buu alone.
Don't do that! We'll help you!
Yeah! If we all gang up on him, we'll beat him easy!
Trunks... You are my only son... And I haven't held you since you were a baby, have I? Come here, son.
What's wrong, Dad? Why are you acting so weird?
Trunks. There's something you need to know...
You've made me proud, son.
Why did you do that? He's your son! You shouldn't do things like that to your son!
Buu big mad!
BUU BIG MAD!!!!
Take the two boys as far away from here as you can.
Of course.
It's time. Hurry!
You're going to die, you know that?
There is one thing I need to know... Tell me... Will I meet that clown Kakarot in the other world?

!I'm not going to lie to you, Vegeta, although the answer may be difficult to hear.Goku dedicated his life to protecting the lives of others. Because of his selflessness, when he died he got to keep his body and travel to the Grand Kai's planet.You on the other hand... When you die, you will not receive the same reward.
Oh, well... So be it... Get out of here, Piccolo! Hurry!
Buu get big mad now! You fight Buu!
That's right.
You look tasty! I make you chocolate!
You're a fool. I'm going to crush you. And throw you into the wind.
I do this for you, Trunks... Bulma... And yes... Even for you, Kakarot!

nodes.text: Are you sensing what I'm sensing?
Yes... Vegeta's energy signal... It's gone! Listen... I'm going out to the battlefield to check things out. Take care of the boys while I'm gone.
You did it, Vegeta! Your sacrifice wasn't in vain! I know it wasn't easy to do that... Especially for a guy like you... I know how much courage it took to do what you did. Goodbye, my friend.
Help... Me...
You're still alive? Why should I help you? You don't like being hurt do you? But you delight in hurting others... I should exterminate you right now!
No! It can't be!
This is insane! What kind of creature is he? He was in a million pieces! How can we beat a monster like that? I'm getting out of here!
Krillin! We're in big trouble. Buu's still alive!
Impossible! How can that be? What about Vegeta?
No. There wasn't even anything left of him.
But if an attack like that doesn't affect Buu what are we going to do?
There is hope. But if Buu finds it, he'll destroy it! It's Goten and Trunks.
Son of Goku! Son of Vegeta! The fate of the world depends on you two!
Man... Vegeta must have knocked me out. Hmmm... I wonder how the others are doing.

I can still sense Buu... But where are Gohan and Vegeta? I don't sense them. Something terrible has happened. I can sense Piccolo and Krillin over at Kami's Lookout. Maybe they know what's going on...

nodes.text: What's going on? We've been sitting here for hours!
You just don't get it do you? I'm awakening your sleeping powers! I can take a person beyond their limits! Turn the kitten into a lion! The robin into an eagle!
You already told me that and you said we'd be done right now! We don't exactly have all the time in the world! Don't you see what's going on back on Earth?
I've had enough of your games!
That power... It worked! Sorry I yelled at you sir!
Perfect... Gohan has ascended past his previous limitations.
Incredible!  He's stronger than he ever was as a Super Saiyan, but he looks like he hasn't changed a bit.
And just in time. Things are not looking so good on Earth right now...
I will take Gohan back to Earth.
Say Kibito...
What is it Gohan?
You know that trick you did before to change my clothes? My father is the greatest fighter ever, and I want to fight in the same clothing that he does.
Of course... You're quite respectful!
Gohan... Please don't leave us and the world disappointed.
Journal Entry: Save Goten and Trunks from Super Buu.

nodes.text: Buu is changing! But into what?
Oh, no! He's changed back to normal!We're doomed!
What do you mean he's turned back to normal? Do you know something you haven't told me?
This is Buu's original form! You see...
Many eons ago, the Supreme Kais were enjoying a long reign of peace under Daikaioh, our benevolent leader. Although we had enjoyed a period of harmony, a period of great disharmony was to follow!

!We had no way to prepare ourselves for the evil creation that the wizard Bibidi was about to unleash on the universe! It was Majin Buu in his original form. One by one the Supreme Kais fell to his terror!
@I too would have perished; however, I was saved by Daikaioh.
!I'll never forget what happened next. Buu absorbed Daikaioh!
!It was Daikaioh's innocent purity that transformed Buu from a ruthless killing machine into a frolicking rotund child.
I see... So absorbing Daikaioh actually weakened Buu.
That's correct. Without the influence of Daikaioh's goodness inside him, he's pure unrestrained evil!

nodes.text: Superb! You're still alive!
!Gohan... Goten... Trunks... Piccolo... I let you all down...
!Idiot! How could you? You save the Namek boy and that big oaf instead of your own sons?Have you lost your mind?
How could Buu destroy the Earth? It's all gone!!!
!The Earth is gone you say? Who are you trying to fool? Where do you think we are right now? Huh?Put that in your diaper old man!
!Please! You don't know what you're saying! This isn't the Earth!This is the hallowed Planet Of The Kais! And he's not just a man! He's a Supreme Kai!
!He does look kinda funny. What's a Kai? Some kind of purple leprechaun?
!No! The Kai are the illustrious overseers of the universe!

!So if they're so great, why didn't they stop Majin Buu? Wait a second... This must be a dream... Just a dumb dream! First of all, I'm the strongest guy on Earth. So there couldn't be anyone stronger than me. Second there is no such thing as pink monsters or purple men with pointy ears... It all makes sense now! I'm just dreaming! And there certainly aren't any little green men who guard the Earth... Hahaha!
!But sir!
!Now that I know this is a dream I can do whatever I want! I bet I could even fly! Hahaha!
Owww... How can this hurt so bad if this is just a dream...
!Do you see what we have to put up with because of your incompetence, Kakarot?
Everyone look at this!
What is it? Looks like a bunch of rocks!
It's what's left of Earth... But look at that!
Pink... Blobs!
It's Buu! He's reforming!
Of course he is! Did you think that blast was powerful enough to destroy him?
He just used Instant Transmission! Now he can travel at the speed of light! This is terrible! With Instant Transmission, he can destroy an entire solar system in less than an hour!
Wait! What about the Dragon Balls!
What are you talking about? They were destroyed with the Earth!
No! I mean the ones on New Namek!
Good thinking Dende! If we use those we can wish back the Earth and all the people who were killed!
I don't mean to alarm you, but Buu just blew up another world. He keeps blowing himself up and then reforming! What an insane creature!
He's looking for Goku and Vegeta! And he won't stop until he finds them!
And with every planet he destroys he's getting closer to the Other World...
If he were to start destroying the Other World it would be terrible! The people here are already dead. If they were to be killed again, they would be gone forever!
The only answer is to call him here. That way we can fight him away from any innocent people!
Of course! Let's do it! If we raise our power levels as high as possible he'll be sure to sense us!
That was quick!
Yes. We can fight as we like here without worries!
Please leave now, you guys! Get out of here! If you stay you'll just get in our way. We can't fight to our full potential if we're worried about your safety.
So you're just going to demolish our sacred planet? Very well... Kick his butt for me will you?
Now that they're gone... Who goes first?
Let's settle this the old fashioned way! Rock paper scissors!
Scissors!
Rock!
Rock crushes scissors. You win, Kakarot! But there's a good chance I'll get my turn anyway.
Well... Here goes!

What is it? Looks like a bunch of rocks!
It's what's left of Earth... But look at that!
Pink... Blobs!
It's Buu! He's reforming!
Of course he is! Did you think that blast was powerful enough to destroy him?
He just used Instant Transmission! Now he can travel at the speed of light! This is terrible! With Instant Transmission, he can destroy an entire solar system in less than an hour!
Wait! What about the Dragon Balls!
What are you talking about? They were destroyed with the Earth!
No! I mean the ones on New Namek!
Good thinking Dende! If we use those we can wish back the Earth and all the people who were killed!
I don't mean to alarm you, but Buu just blew up another world. He keeps blowing himself up and then reforming! What an insane creature!
He's looking for Goku and Vegeta! And he won't stop until he finds them!
And with every planet he destroys he's getting closer to the Other World...
If he were to start destroying the Other World it would be terrible! The people here are already dead. If they were to be killed again, they would be gone forever!
The only answer is to call him here. That way we can fight him away from any innocent people!
Of course! Let's do it! If we raise our power levels as high as possible he'll be sure to sense us!
That was quick!
Yes. We can fight as we like here without worries!
Please leave now, you guys! Get out of here! If you stay you'll just get in our way. We can't fight to our full potential if we're worried about your safety.
So you're just going to demolish our sacred planet? Very well... Kick his butt for me will you?
Now that they're gone... Who goes first?
Let's settle this the old fashioned way! Rock paper scissors!
Scissors!
Rock!
Rock crushes scissors. You win, Kakarot! But there's a good chance I'll get my turn anyway.
Well... Here goes!

nodes.text: Kakarot! I know this is your turn, but I'd like to cut in!
If it's okay with you!
Yeah... Sure... Be my guest...
Be careful, Vegeta!
Peek-a-buu!!!!

nodes.text: Kakarot... I can't do it. I'm no match for him... It's over...
I'll take over for now.
Amazing... How do you do it, Kakarot? You're always ready to meet the challenge. Even if it's bigger than you are!

When you became a Super Saiyan so many years ago, it tore me apart. How could a lower class soldier accomplish so easily what I had struggled my whole life to achieve? I lived every moment for the sole purpose of surpassing you... But no matter how strong I became your power still exceeded mine! You showed mercy to your fiercest enemies. You never fought to kill or for revenge! Only to test your limits or push yourself beyond them.
But perhaps it was my anger that made me blind to the truth... I see it now. This day has made it clear to me! You're better than me, Kakarot. You're the best!
!Me Buu kill you!
Well, you wouldn't be the first to do that... But what I represent can never be destroyed, Buu!

nodes.text: Hahahahaha!
I feel like a hamster in a wheel... It doesn't matter how much energy I put out! I still don't get anywhere. Why don't you take over for a while?
You know better than anyone that I don't stand a chance against Buu. He'd tear me apart!
What? You'll do fine!

Don't give me that. I know what you're trying to do, Kakarot, so forget it! Go get him. Don't worry about me. You're a Super Saiyan 3. You should be able to generate the power to destroy that monster!
Well, maybe I could have done it when I was at full strength, but I let the fight drag on too long so you could have a shot. I should have done it while I had a chance! Now I'm weak! I'll need time!
How much time?
If I even had one minute. Just one minute with no interruptions...
In this fight, a minute could be an eternity... Alright! You got your minute!
Wait! You could get killed!
If I can't last one lousy minute, maybe I deserve to die!
